purpose: Make the project's accumulated research artifacts discoverable and reusable by future research runs and agents.

artifacts.description: Deep research prompts covering product research plus project-specific architecture, status, artifact, CI, extraction, evidence and acceptance questions.
Turns the query corpus into deterministic research-plan contract checks and records coverage/failure causes with explicit evidence-tier semantics.
Canonical benchmark execution-tier semantics preventing deterministic or simulated results from being interpreted as live-provider, integration-runtime or production evidence.
Produces per-observation transport and structural signals such as latency, response bytes, product-candidate hints and JSON-LD counts. These are not field-level correctness evidence.
Aggregates autonomous benchmark shards, research-contract coverage and structural acquisition signals while preserving explicit correctness measurement gaps.

Executable validation of artifact classification, project-query coverage, complete nightly lane/diagnosis/project-summary/baseline bundle integrity when present, and the boundary between transport/structural signals and field-level correctness.
Compares nightly project-research summaries and reports explicit NO_BASELINE, IMPROVED, REGRESSED or STABLE decisions.

Eleven-task overnight research loop covering acquisition, mapping, chatbot quality, restricted evidence, temporal reconciliation, search/model efficiency, architecture, performance and next-night synthesis.
Structured schema for tasks, source visits, findings, novelty, confidence, engineering actions and next tasks. It defines how evidence can become reusable; it is not itself empirical evidence.
Canonical URL/task deduplication and explicit revisit-reason enforcement for nightly research.
Model/agent behavior cases for regression benchmarking.
Structured contract for agent behavior evaluation.
Public benchmark target set used by autonomous acquisition tests.

reusable_evidence_rules: A benchmark definition is not empirical evidence.
A benchmark summary is operational evidence, not field-level product correctness unless an oracle is present.
A finding becomes reusable evidence only when it has a source URL, task context, novelty classification and bounded confidence.
Transport success must not be treated as product-field precision or recall.
Structural product-candidate or JSON-LD signals are hints about page shape, not proof that extracted product fields are correct.
Current project state must be tied to a revision and timestamp before being reused as a current claim.
A regression result must name the compared baseline; NO_BASELINE is a truthful state, not a pass.
Every benchmark artifact must carry an explicit execution evidence tier; lower-tier evidence cannot certify higher-tier runtime or production claims.

A nightly research bundle is reusable only when its lane manifests, diagnosis, project-improvement summary and baseline are internally consistent for the same run; missing runtime artifacts are absence of evidence, not a pass.
search_priorities: new source families and previously unseen domains
